subject: monkfish
title: A Fish on the Seafloor Has Been Found Full of Ducks and Seabirds

scenes.text: A fish that lives on the seafloor keeps turning up with birds inside it.
One monkfish was found with seven wild ducks inside, all from a single meal.
Others held loons, cormorants and gulls. Hunters even watched one swallow a live gull whole.
In 2013, fourteen monkfish caught off Cape Cod each had a seabird in its stomach.
The trick is a mouth wider than its body, and patience. It lies still, then rises and gulps.
Birds dive to hunt fish. Sometimes the fish is waiting.

description:
The American monkfish, or goosefish, usually waits on the seafloor, but birds have been found in its stomach: loons, cormorants, gulls, and once seven ducks in one fish.
In 2013, 14 goosefish caught off Cape Cod each held a dovekie. Bird meals are rare, but this fish swallows almost anything that fits its huge mouth.
Would you have guessed a fish could eat a duck?
first_comment: A 26-inch goosefish was once found with a 23-inch cod inside it. What's the strangest thing you've seen a fish eat?
